annotations.title: Apply to a job from AIApply search

description: Use this when the connected user wants AIApply to apply to a job they picked from search_jobs. AIApply adds it to their queue already approved, so it does not wait for anyone: it will be applied for and that spends a credit. This is the only point the user is asked, so call it without confirmed, show them the job, ask them, then call again with confirmed=true. Adding the same job twice is refused rather than repeated. If the account is not set up yet, it says so: call get_setup_status first. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one. It also needs a permission the user grants; if it was not granted, calling it asks the user to allow it. A job_id from search_jobs stays valid after either.

confirmed.description: True only after the user has explicitly agreed to apply for this job.

search_job_id.description: The job_id from search_jobs. Not the job_id from list_review_jobs.

name: apply_to_job

applies_after.description: applying_active when the job waits in the queue until applying is active on the account.

dashboard_url.description: The AIApply dashboard, where the user manages Auto Apply.

error.description: True when the job could not be added.

queued.description: True only when the job was added.

reason.description: Why nothing was added, when nothing was.

updates_offer.description: Present once, when the account is first ready: something you may offer the user. Act on it only if they agree.

user_message.description: Show this to the user rather than message.
